name: NTNH-Server
author: NTNH Team
description:
Nuclear Tech: New Horizons modpack server for Minecraft 1.7.10.

Requires Java 8 and at least 4 GB RAM.

On first install the egg clones the repo and resolves any Git LFS pointer files via the GitHub LFS batch API (no git-lfs install required).

installation.script:
#! /bin/bash
# NTNH-Server installation script
# Dependencies: git, curl, unzip, python3

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git curl unzip python3

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Clone the repo (shallow clone for speed)
git init
git remote add origin https://github.com/NTNewHorizons/NTNH-Server.git
git fetch --depth 1 origin main
git checkout main

# Resolve LFS pointer files via the GitHub LFS batch API (resolve-lfs.py is in the repo)
echo "Resolving Git LFS pointer files..."
python3 resolve-lfs.py || exit 1

# Verify critical files exist and are real jars (not LFS pointers)
for f in server.jar minecraft_server.1.7.10.jar; do
    if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: required file $f is missing."
        exit 1
    fi
    if head -n1 "$f" | grep -q "version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1"; then
        echo "ERROR: $f is still a Git LFS pointer (download failed)."
        exit 1
    fi
done

# Ensure line endings are Unix
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh
chmod +x start.sh

echo "Installation complete. Server will start on boot."

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players that can join the server.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day shown on the server list.
